definitions.failure_start: The exact M39/VOT progress index: first frame of ten consecutive overlap <= 0.1 frames.
definitions.driving_state: The previous trajectory prediction, or anchor GT for the first post-initialization frame.
definitions.crop_geometry: Exact STTrack sample_target geometry: ceil(sqrt(w*h)*factor), centered with Python round, with padding outside the image.
definitions.inside_factor4: GT target center is inside the official factor-4 crop at failure onset.
definitions.factor6_only: GT center is outside factor-4 but inside factor-6.
definitions.factor7_only: GT center is outside factor-6 but inside factor-7.
definitions.outside_factor7: GT center is outside all three tested crops.
definitions.interpretation_limit: Crop coverage is candidate-availability geometry only; it does not prove that wider inference would select or recover the target.

claim_ceiling: Read-only diagnosis of the completed M39 default low22 trajectories. It is not a new tracker, metric, checkpoint, training set, or authorization for full127.
